samples.question: The image shows eight separate vertical slices standing side by side. Each slice is a stack of 8 square cells and some cells are filled dark. Under every slice a coloured key bar is printed, and all eight bars have different heights. The slices were cut from one 8x8 sheet and then shuffled; a slice's bar height gives its place in that sheet, shortest bar leftmost and tallest bar rightmost. Put the eight slices back in that order, keeping every slice upright and unchanged. The dark cells of the rebuilt 8x8 sheet then match one of these symbols: ex, frame, tee, ell, diamond. Which symbol do they most closely match? Answer with one word.
